about: Shared rules for "Continue on other devices" (Rimelight desktop 0.6.2, Rimelight for Android 1.6.1; up to desktop 0.6.1 and Android 1.6.0 the apps were called ClearPlay). Desktop runs these in tools/dev-rig/queue-handoff-unit.mjs against src/service/queue-handoff.ts; Android copies this file unchanged and runs the same cases against QueueHandoff.kt. Change this file first, in both apps, when a rule changes. Times are server times (ISO 8601) except nowMs (this device clock, epoch ms). Long lists are written as {"generate":{"prefix":"s","from":A,"to":B,"step":K}}: the ids s<i> for i = A, A+K, ... while i < B. As songs, each is {"id":"s<i>","local":false}, except with "localEvery":N, where i % N == N-1 is local.
notes: v4: The apps send Rimelight (desktop) and Rimelight-Android. ClearPlay and ClearPlay-Android (legacyNames) are the same two apps before the rename, not updated yet: a name counts as the app it maps to everywhere ("the other app", "this app"). Names are compared exactly, case and all.
v4: A queue saved under this app's old name (by this device before it updated) is this app's own queue: no offer.
v4: The live position is taken from a Now Playing entry of the same app as changedBy, under either name (the phone may have updated between saving and playing).
v4: The device name shows the name the other app sent: "ClearPlay Android" for a phone not updated yet, "Rimelight Android" after.
v3: Live position (Now Playing) is trusted only from the other app, playing or paused. Any other app: the saved song and position, kind "saved" ("Saved by <app> · <song> · <age>").
v3: <song> in every pill is the song Continue starts (offer.song), never the Now Playing song when that one is not in the saved queue.
v3: Left behind needs a candidate Now Playing entry (leftBehindCandidate) AND the server queue changedBy = the other app (leftBehind). Read the queue only when there is a candidate.
v3: On a song change, run the left-behind check first, then schedule that change's save (otherwise the device left behind could save first and make itself changedBy).
Left behind shows once per period away: alreadyShown is set when it shows and cleared when this device saves successfully.
Server times (changed, handledChanged) are compared as instants, never as strings and never with this device's clock.
A saved currentIndex past the end of the entries is clamped to the last song.
saveWindow never fills up from before the current song: at most 100 before, the rest after.
ageText: "yesterday" is 24 to 48 hours of elapsed time, not the calendar day.
A song change counts as natural (not a skip; it does not close the left-behind pill) when the previous song was within 3 s of its end (isNaturalEnd).
Clearing the queue = only the playing song is left (isQueueCleared); it is not saved.

saveWindow.name: short queue: everything, current index unchanged
current at 2950 of 3000: 100 before, the 50 left after (no filling up from before)
the same song twice: index points at the second copy
local songs mixed in: left out, index moves with them
every second song local (3000): left out before the window is taken, so 100 saved songs before and 749 after
current song is local: nothing to save
index out of range: nothing to save

debounce.name: 5 fast skips = 1 save, 4 s after the last
song change then pause: one save, 0.5 s after the pause
quit saves right away and drops the waiting save
spaced song changes: one save each

offer.name: no handledChanged yet, phone gone from Now Playing: offered (paused, saved song and position)
saved by this app: nothing
Android sees its own queue: nothing
Android sees the desktop queue
changed older than handledChanged: nothing
changed equal to handledChanged: nothing
equal instant written differently: nothing
changed newer than handledChanged: offered
something is playing here: nothing
empty server queue: nothing
no server queue: nothing
other Rimelight app still playing: its song and live position
v3: other Rimelight app paused in Now Playing: its song and position
v3: a song before the current one was deleted (server index now points one too far): the paused entry finds the right song
v3: playing and paused entries of the other app: the playing one wins
playing song twice in the queue: the first match at or after the saved index
playing song only before the saved index: the first match anywhere
v3: playing song not in the saved queue: kind "playing", but song, index and position are the saved ones (the pill names the saved song)
another user playing: ignored
another player of the same user playing: ignored
v3: saved by Symfonium, nothing in Now Playing: "saved", saved song and position
v3: saved by Symfonium and it shows as playing: not trusted, saved song and position
v3: saved by Symfonium and it shows as paused: not trusted either
v3: Android sees a Symfonium queue: "saved"
saved current index out of range: clamped to the last song
a clock 10 min off changes nothing (no clock in the rules)
v4: desktop, saved by ClearPlay Android 1.6.0 (old name) and still playing there: its song and live position
v4: Android, saved by ClearPlay desktop 0.6.1 (old name) and paused there: its song and position
v4: desktop sees the queue it saved as ClearPlay before it updated: nothing
v4: Android sees the queue it saved as ClearPlay-Android before it updated: nothing
v4: saved as ClearPlay-Android, the phone has updated and now plays as Rimelight-Android: still trusted
v4: names are exact: "clearplay-android" is another app, "saved"
v4: saved by the phone, but the Now Playing entry is an old desktop (this app's kind): not trusted, saved song and position

leftBehindCandidate.name: the other Rimelight app plays a song from this queue: read the server queue
nobody else playing: no need to read the queue
v4: ClearPlay Android 1.6.0 (old name) plays a song from this queue: read the server queue
v4: ClearPlay desktop 0.6.1 seen from Rimelight Android
v4: this app under its old name (another copy not updated): nothing

leftBehind.name: Android plays a song from this queue and saved last
v3: this device took over (it saved last): nothing, even though the other app still plays
v3: server queue not read (no candidate): nothing
already shown since this device last saved: nothing
shows again once this device has saved (alreadyShown cleared)
song not in this queue: nothing
Symfonium playing: nothing (only the other Rimelight app)
v4: ClearPlay Android 1.6.0 continued (saved last as ClearPlay-Android)
v4: this desktop saved last as ClearPlay, before it updated: nothing
v4: the phone plays under its old name and saved last under its new one: found
v4: Rimelight desktop seen from Android, saved last as ClearPlay before it updated

isNaturalEnd.name: just over 3 s before the end: a skip

isQueueCleared.name: one other song left (not the playing one)
emptied (nothing left): not a clear to save around, nothing to save anyway
